title: Recruiter Portal & ATS Candidate Pipeline 10/10 Overhaul (Google M3 / Cuba Executive Token Harmonization & In-Modal Review)
spec:
1. CONTEXT & PROBLEM:
- The Employer / Recruiter Portal (/employer/*, EmployerDashboard.jsx, EmployerApplicantPipeline.jsx, CompaniesManagement.jsx) must be elevated to the exact 10/10 Google Material 3 / Cuba Executive standard certified in DIR-008 (Organization) and DIR-009 (Candidate).
- Action buttons across recruiter sub-surfaces (Post a Job, Review Candidate, Status Transitions, Filter Candidates) must be harmonized to canonical Cuba tokens (.cuba-btn-primary and --cuba-primary-fill #5949d6).
- Candidate review in the ATS pipeline modal must render high-fidelity candidate resume details cleanly without clipped containers or styling regressions.
- Single chrome enforcement: exactly one Cuba AppShell sidebar and unique ARIA landmarks per recruiter route.

2. REQUIRED ARCHITECTURAL CHANGES:
- Audit and tokenize Recruiter components (EmployerDashboard.jsx, EmployerApplicantPipeline.jsx, JobManagement.jsx, CompaniesManagement.jsx) to canonical Cuba design tokens.
- Ensure candidate resume in-modal preview displays correctly with genuine MariaDB applicant data.
- Standardize candidate status transition pills (Shortlisted, Interviewing, Offered, Rejected) with high-contrast WCAG 2.1 AA tokens.
- Enforce unique landmark nav naming and visible keyboard focus rings across all recruiter sub-tabs.

3. VERIFICATION & ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- Author Playwright E2E suite tests/e2e/dir010-recruiter-portal.spec.js and playwright.dir010.config.js running against live Vite (:3000) and MariaDB (:8080).
- Assert single Cuba chrome and unique nav landmarks across all recruiter routes.
- Assert all recruiter action CTAs use canonical Cuba primary tokens.
- Assert in-modal candidate resume review renders unclipped with live data.
- Assert zero console errors, zero page errors, and zero failed API requests.
- Verify 51 CV templates and DOCX export pipeline remain 100% frozen (diff = 0 vs e314f715).
invariants: 51 CV templates (Cv1-Cv51) remain 100% frozen (git diff = 0 vs e314f715).

WCAG 2.1 AA compliance: text contrast >= 4.5:1, focus indicator >= 3:1.
Production build Vite bundles in < 4s with 0 errors.
